title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p><strong>ROLE SUMMARY</strong></p> <p>The Senior AI Security Engineer - AI Products &amp; Applications will be embedded within the AI &amp; Applications team to enable the secure design, development, release, and operation of AI products and applications. The role works directly with AI engineers, application engineers, product managers, inference engineers, DevOps, and platform teams to build practical security controls into agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model-serving APIs, enterprise-data integrations, and user-facing AI experiences.</p> <p>This is a product- and application-oriented security role. The engineer will help teams deliver trusted AI features without unnecessarily slowing innovation, while ensuring that AI products protect customer, enterprise, and operational data. The role reports operationally to the Head of AI &amp; Applications, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Cybersecurity to maintain alignment with enterprise security strategy, risk management, compliance requirements, and incident-response processes.</p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with AI product, application, and engineering teams from discovery through production to define secure-by-design architectures for AI-powered products and services.</li> <li>Threat-model LLM-enabled and agentic workflows, including direct and indirect prompt injection, data exfiltration, unsafe tool use, excessive agent permissions, cross-tenant access, model abuse, and unintended autonomous actions.</li> <li>Design secure patterns for agent identity, delegated authorization, scoped credentials, tool allowlists, approval gates, action validation, execution sandboxing, rollback, and auditability.</li> <li>Secure RAG and enterprise-knowledge workflows, including document ingestion, indexing, retrieval permissions, metadata filtering, source attribution, tenant isolation, sensitive-data classification, and data-retention controls.</li> <li>Define security controls for user-facing AI products, including authentication, authorization, consent, rate limiting, abuse detection, content and output controls, conversation-data handling, and customer-facing audit trails.</li> <li>Secure model-serving and inference APIs through workload identity, API authentication, tenant-aware access controls, quotas, request validation, model access policies, usage monitoring, and logging controls.</li> <li>Build reusable AI security guardrails, libraries, reference architectures, templates, policy-as-code, and developer tooling that make secure implementation the default path for product teams.</li> <li>Work with DevOps and Platform teams to ensure Kubernetes, custom job-scheduler integrations, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, containers, and runtime environments provide the required security posture for AI applications.</li> <li>Lead vulnerability management for AI application dependencies, model-serving runtimes, agent frameworks, SDKs, APIs, containers, CUDA and GPU software components, and related infrastructure.</li> <li>Embed security requirements into application design reviews, pull-request and CI/CD controls, release processes, operational runbooks, and incident-response procedures.</li> <li>Develop security telemetry and detections for anomalous agent actions, unsafe tool calls, unusual data retrieval, credential misuse, inference API abuse, suspicious workload behavior, and policy violations.</li> <li>Act as the principal security liaison between AI &amp; Applications and the Cybersecurity function, coordinating architecture reviews, security exceptions, risk acceptance, compliance evidence, incident response, and remediation tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, platform security, or a related field.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience embedding security practices into software engineering or product-development teams and supporting secure delivery from design through production.</li> <li>Strong understanding of application security, API security, secure software development lifecycle practices, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and security automation.</li> <li>Practical understanding of AI and LLM application security risks, including prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure tool use, excessive agency, model abuse, sensitive-data exposure, cross-tenant data leakage, and supply-chain risks.</li> <li>Experience securing agentic applications, RAG systems, enterprise search, vector databases, model-serving APIs, enterprise-data connectors, or comparable AI-enabled systems.</li> <li>Experience designing identity and access controls using OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SSO, RBAC, ABAC, workload identity, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and container security, including admission controls, network policies, RBAC, runtime protection, image scanning, software supply-chain security, and policy engines.</li> <li>Experience with secure CI/CD, dependency governance, SBOMs, image signing, provenance, artifact management, and controlled-release processes.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar language for automation, security tooling, integrations, and analysis.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud and infrastructure security, including logging, monitoring, incident response, encryption, key management, and security controls for multi-tenant systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Controls, OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Top 10, or equivalent frameworks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>KEY COMPETENCIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Secure-by-design AI product and application engineering.</li> <li>Threat modeling for LLM, RAG, agentic, and autonomous workflows.</li> <li>Application, API, identity, and authorization security.</li> <li>Secure AI data flows, retrieval controls, and tenant isolation.</li> <li>Agent governance, tool authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, and action auditability.</li> <li>Kubernetes, container, CI/CD, and software supply-chain security.</li> <li>Risk-based prioritization that balances product velocity, user experience, operational reliability, and security requirements.</li> <li>Developer enablement through reusable guardrails, secure patterns, automation, and clear documentation.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional communication with AI engineers, product teams, platform teams, DevOps, legal/compliance stakeholders, and Cybersecurity leadership.</li> <li>Ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving AI product environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>SUCCESS METRICS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Percentage of AI products, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and inference services that complete security design review before production release.</li> <li>Adoption rate of reusable security patterns, guardrails, libraries, templates, and policy controls across AI &amp; Applications projects.</li> <li>Coverage of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, approval gates, audit logging, secrets management, and data-protection controls across AI applications.</li> <li>Reduction in critical and high-risk security findings discovered late in development, during release, or after production deployment.</li> <li>Mean time to identify, triage, and remediate vulnerabilities affecting AI applications, agent frameworks, model-serving components, APIs, and dependencies.</li> <li>Reduction in unsafe or unauthorized agent actions, insecure tool calls, sensitive-data exposure events, abnormal retrieval attempts, and inference API abuse.</li> <li>Security readiness of AI product releases, including completion of threat models, architecture reviews, security testing, operational runbooks, and exception approvals.</li> <li>Demonstrable improvement in the time required for product teams to adopt approved security controls and obtain production-release clearance.</li> <li>Quality and completeness of security telemetry, audit evidence, incident investigations, and post-incident remediation.</li> </ul> <p>Effective execution of the dotted-line operating model, including consistent alignment with the Head of Cybersecurity on risk posture, standards, escalations, compliance, title: AI Engineer - Inference
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p><strong>ROLE SUMMARY</strong></p> <p>The Senior AI Engineer (Inferencing) will build and improve the AI &amp; Applications team’s inference capability, making models available as reliable, secure, scalable, and high-performance endpoints for internal products, external customers, and future Inference-as-a-service offerings.</p> <p>The role will establish the engineering foundation for self-hosted model serving in the organization’s AI-factory environment. This includes model onboarding, deployment, endpoint provisioning, runtime selection, performance benchmarking and optimization, observability, capacity management, security, and operational lifecycle management. The objective is to provide users with predictable and efficient access to models while maintaining control over performance, cost, data handling, deployment configuration, and infrastructure utilization.</p> <p>The role is a key contributor to the Model-to-Grid product and agentic applications roadmap. It will convert model and runtime characteristics into benchmarked, repeatable inference recipes and endpoint profiles that can inform workload scheduling, topology-aware placement, capacity planning, performance recommendations, and operational decision-making. It will also provide the governed and fit-for-purpose model endpoints needed by agentic systems for reasoning, retrieval, tool use, diagnosis, recommendation, and controlled automation.</p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, operate, and continuously improve self-hosted AI inference services for internal applications, customer-facing products, and future Inference-as-a-service offerings.</li> <li>Define and implement standard model-onboarding workflows covering model intake, compatibility validation, packaging, runtime selection, optimization, deployment, endpoint registration, testing, release, and lifecycle management.</li> <li>Provision and manage secure, scalable inference endpoints for common AI application patterns, including interactive generation, RAG, embeddings, reranking, batch processing, multimodal use cases, tool calling, and agentic workflows.</li> <li>Develop reusable deployment templates, APIs, SDKs, configuration standards, and self-service workflows for users to request, configure, access, monitor, update, and retire model endpoints.</li> <li>Work with leading inference frameworks and toolkits, such as TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, SGLang, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, NVIDIA NIM, CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, and related serving, profiling, and observability tools.</li> <li>Optimize model-serving performance using appropriate techniques, including quantization, compilation, batching, continuous batching, request routing, KV-cache management, prefix caching, speculative decoding, load balancing, model routing, memory optimization, and distributed parallelism.</li> <li>Build and validate reusable inference recipes that specify compatible model versions, framework and runtime versions, precision formats, GPU configurations, topology requirements, scaling approaches, scheduler profiles, benchmark results, and expected performance envelopes.</li> <li>Use quantization and optimization approaches such as NVFP4, FP8, INT8, TensorRT compilation, kernel optimization, efficient attention mechanisms, and memory-management techniques while maintaining agreed model-quality targets.</li> <li>Design distributed inference configurations for large models, including tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism where appropriate.</li> <li>Work with the Kubernetes and proprietary scheduler team to define endpoint resource profiles, placement requirements, topology preferences, priority classes, quota models, autoscaling rules, capacity reservations, and workload-management policies.</li> <li>Contribute inference workload characteristics, benchmarks, and performance profiles to the Model-to-Grid product so that endpoint placement, scheduling, capacity planning, and AI-factory operations can make more informed decisions.</li> <li>Build benchmarking and qualification workflows using controlled experiments, reproducible baselines, load tests, latency tests, throughput tests, concurrency tests, scaling tests, performance profiling, regression testing, and internal or industry-standard benchmark methodologies where relevant.</li> <li>Measure and improve key inference indicators, including time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, tokens per second, requests per second, end-to-end latency, concurrency, GPU utilization, memory efficiency, cache hit rate, scaling efficiency, power efficiency, and cost efficiency.</li> <li>Establish automated performance-regression testing and release qualification for model versions, runtime and toolkit upgrades, CUDA and driver changes, Kubernetes releases, scheduler changes, networking and storage changes, and new GPU platforms.</li> <li>Build operational observability for inference services, including endpoint availability, request volume, latency, queueing, errors, GPU utilization, GPU memory use, cache behavior, capacity, cost, power, and service-level objectives.</li> <li>Partner with the agentic applications team to provide fit-for-purpose self-hosted endpoints for agent planning, retrieval, tool use, summarization, diagnosis, recommendation, optimization, and AI-factory operations.</li> <li>Expose governed inference, benchmark, recipe, performance, and capacity information to agentic systems, allowing them to recommend suitable models, identify degradation, diagnose bottlenecks, plan optimization experiments, and validate results.</li> <li>Work with Product, UX, DevOps, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and Global Operations teams to ensure that inference provisioning, model selection, endpoint configuration, performance visibility, quota management, and troubleshooting are clear, secure, and operationally supportable.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in AI inference, model serving, ML systems, high-performance computing, distributed systems, or comparable performance-critical environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience building, operating, or materially improving production model-serving platforms, inference APIs, GPU-backed services, AI developer platforms, or multi-tenant AI systems.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one or more modern inference frameworks, such as TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, SGLang, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face Text Generation Inference, or equivalent technologies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the NVIDIA AI software stack, including CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, TensorRT, GPU profiling, distributed communication, and GPU performance analysis.</li> <li>Practical understanding of LLM and generative-AI serving behavior, including prompt processing, token generation, batching, context length, concurrency, KV-cache management, prefill and decode performance, request scheduling, model routing, and latency-throughput trade-offs.</li> <li>Experience with model optimization methods, including quantization, compilation, calibration, mixed precision, kernel fusion, memory optimization, caching, speculative decoding, parallelism, and accuracy-performance validation.</li> <li>Strong Python skills and working proficiency in C++ or Go for inference services, APIs, automation, benchmarking, profiling, runtime integrations, and performance-critical development.</li> <li>Experience with distributed inference or training patterns, including tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism; collective communication; fault handling; and multi-node scaling.</li> <li>Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, GitOps, service APIs, autoscaling, workload scheduling, observability, and production multi-tenant platform operations.</li> <li>Understanding of high-performance GPU infrastructure, including GPU topology, NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, NUMA, NIC affinity, RDMA, RoCEv2, network fabrics, storage throughput, and their impact on inference performance.</li> <li>Experience with inference benchmarking, performance profiling, reproducibility, load testing, regression testing, and analysis of throughput, latency, utilization, scaling, power, and cost metrics.</li> <li>Familiarity with model-serving use cases such as RAG, embeddings, reranking, multimodal inference, agentic applications, model routing, and tool-calling workflows.</li> <li>Understanding of security and governance for inference services, including identity, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, quotas, rate limiting, secrets handling, audit logging, abuse prevention, and data protection.</li> </ul> <p><strong>KEY COMPETENCIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Self-hosted inference platform engineering and production ownership.</li> <li>Model serving, endpoint provisioning, lifecycle management, and developer self-service experience.</li> <li>Inference-as-a-service foundations, including multi-tenancy, scalable endpoint operations, usage visibility, quotas, service profiles, and operational supportability.</li> <li>High-performance LLM, generative-AI, embedding, reranking, and multimodal inference optimization.</li> <li>Practical use of modern inference frameworks, model-serving toolkits, GPU profiling tools, and benchmarking methods.</li> <li>Development of validated, repeatable, versioned inference recipes and deployment configurations.</li> <li>Quantitative performance engineering across latency, throughput, GPU utilization, memory, scaling, power, energy, cost, and reliability.</li> <li>Model-to-Grid thinking: connecting endpoint workload characteristics to benchmarking, scheduler policies, topology-aware placement, capacity, power, thermal state, and AI-factory operations.</li> <li>Ability to provide reliable, governed, and cost-efficient inference services for agentic applications and autonomous operational workflows.</li> <li>Cross-functional collaboration with AI applications, Model-to-Grid, scheduling, DevOps, Platform, SDI, Security, UX, product, and global operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>SUCCESS METRICS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Reliable, secure, and scalable self-hosted inference endpoints are available for priority internal applications, external products, Model-to-Grid capabilities, and agentic systems.</li> <li>Reduction in the time required to onboard, validate, optimize, deploy, provision, update, and retire a supported model endpoint.</li> <li>Adoption of standardized inference deployment workflows supported model catalogues, endpoint templates, APIs, SDKs, recipes, and self-service capabilities.</li> <li>Demonstrated foundations for future Inference-as-a-service offerings, including defined service profiles, endpoint lifecycle controls, tenant isolation, quota management, usage measurement, observability, support processes, and release governance.</li> <li>Improvement in inference performance for priority workloads, measured by latency, time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, tokens per second, requests per second, concurrency, GPU utilization, memory efficiency, and scaling efficiency.</li> <li>Reduction in cost per request, cost per token, energy per inference task, and avoidable resource over-provisioning, while maintaining agreed quality, availability, and reliability standards.</li> <li>Number and adoption of benchmark-validated, documented, versioned inference recipes across supported models, frameworks, toolkits, precision formats, endpoint types, GPU configurations, and deployment topologies.</li> <li>Effective use of benchmarking and performance-validation practices to prevent regressions across model updates, runtime upgrades, CUDA or driver changes, infrastructure changes, scheduler releases, and new GPU platforms.</li> <li>Percentage of production endpoints with appropriate authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, quota controls, rate limits, metering, observability, audit logging, documentation, support runbooks, and rollback procedures.</li> <li>Contribution of inference workload profiles and performance data to Model-to-Grid scheduling, capacity planning, placement quality, operational visibility, power efficiency, and user time-to-results.</li> <li>Reliability and performance of endpoints supporting agentic applications, measured through agent task latency, response quality, tool-call completion, workflow success rate, safe automation outcomes, and reduced reliance on unmanaged external model services.</li> </ul> <p><strong>LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Singapore or Australia (Launceston, Hobart, Syndey, Melbourne)</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Employment Basis</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Permanent full-time</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Diversity</strong></h3> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.</p> <p class="p1">Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 23 countries across all continents, with a team of 1,700 employees.</p> <p>Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing tailor-made solutions that address their specific industry challenges. As pioneers in this field, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working alongside the world's leading market players. Our clients span all key economic sectors - industry, retail, luxury, consumer goods, healthcare, and finance - and include major international corporations.</p> <h3><strong>The Data Analytics Team</strong></h3> <p>You will join our Data Analytics Chapter, a team of 60 professionals with expertise across dashboarding, analytics engineering, marketing measurement, and low-code data science. We are one of three technical teams at Artefact (alongside Software Engineering and Data Science), forming a tech community of 160 people. Despite working on different client engagements, we maintain a strong culture of knowledge sharing through dedicated communities of practice. We are growing fast, with the ambition to double our team size over the next five years.</p> <h3><strong>What you will be doing - Key responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform our clients' businesses through effective data collection, processing, and visualization, acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders.</p> <h4><strong>Delivering end-to-end analytics projects</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Frame use cases with business teams, validate data availability, and define the right approach.</li> <li>Design and implement dashboards, data products, and pipelines that drive business decision-making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Driving technical excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Translate business requirements into scalable analytics architectures and pipelines.</li> <li>Apply modern analytics engineering practices and promote best practices in data modeling and testing.</li> <li>Leveraging the latest GenAI developments in order to deliver the maximum value possible for our clients</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Being a trusted advisor</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extract valuable insights and communicate them in clear, actionable terms.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a go-to expert for analytics guidance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Contributing to team development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor junior data analysts and share best practices through workshops and documentation.</li> <li>Contribute to internal accelerators and maintain active technology watch.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Qualifications - What we are looking for</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for profiles with deep expertise in one of the following domains, combined with openness to work across others. Our flexible career track allows you to specialize or develop a broader skill set.</p> <h3><strong>Core requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of hands-on experience in a data-driven environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise in at least one of the following domains: <ul> <li><strong>Dashboarding &amp; Data Visualization: </strong>Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or Superset.</li> <li><strong>Analytics Engineering: </strong>dbt, with experience on BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks.</li> <li><strong>Marketing Analytics &amp; Measurement: </strong>CDP platforms (Treasure Data, Hightouch, Tealium), MMM, attribution, clean rooms.</li> <li><strong>Low-Code / No-Code Data Science: </strong>Dataiku, Copilot Studio, or similar platforms.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Solid foundation in SQL and Python.</li> <li>Familiarity with Git and software engineering fundamentals (versioning, testing, code quality).</li> <li>Experience working in cloud environments (GCP, Azure, or AWS).</li> </ul> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4><strong>Nice to have</strong></h4> <p>Experience with generative AI applied to analytics (MCP for BI, conversational data interfaces), exposure to multiple domains above, knowledge of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.</p> <p>Beyond technical expertise, we value: intellectual curiosity, pragmatism and creativity, ability to bridge business and technical teams, autonomy and reliability, and clear communication to build client trust.</p> <h3><strong>Our recruitment process</strong></h3> <ol> <li>HR call&nbsp;</li> <li>Technical Interview&nbsp;</li> <li>Business Interview</li> <li>Fit Interview</li> </ol> <p><em>At Artefact, we recruit our employees only on the basis of our needs and the individual qualities of each candidate. We ensure the development of their professional skills and responsibilities without discrimination of any kind, including belief, gender, age, disability, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, membership of a political organization, religion, trade union or minority group.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

  • Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts.

  • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design high-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs optimized for precision, power, and area, driving Arago’s prototype and product iterations from architecture to silicon validation.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate analog and RF integrated circuits, including critical blocks such as amplifiers, mixers, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, and bias/reference circuits, with a focus on signal integrity, linearity, and precision.

  • Optimize circuits for power, area, and performance trade-offs, ensuring designs meet system-level requirements across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.

  • Collaborate closely with optics, simulation and PCB teams to define architecture and block-level specifications for Arago’s successive prototypes and product iterations, ensuring tight alignment with overall performance and integration goals.

  • Work with layout engineers to guide floor-planning and physical design, minimizing parasitic effects and preserving analog precision in layout-sensitive blocks.

  • Support post-silicon validation and bring-up, defining test plans, analyzing lab measurements, and correlating results with simulation to refine future design iterations.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • A sound mathematical understanding and deep physical intuition of analog electronics, as well as analog voltage-to-current and current-to-voltage conversion at low and high frequencies.

  • Experience in designing high-precision analog systems for signal processing or power electronics. Experience working with high-frequency analog signals is valued.

  • Extensive experience in IC design and post-layout design methodology using standard industry tools like Cadence Virtuoso.

  • Proficiency in designing and optimizing mixed-signal circuits, including DACs and ADCs at low (kHz-MHz) and high (>GHz) frequencies, and signal conditioning circuits, ensuring flawless integration between analog RF components and digital processors.

  • Strong understanding of signal integrity, crosstalk, and noise reduction techniques in mixed-signal environments, particularly in high-frequency RF systems interfacing with digital processors.

  • Advanced node experience required (<28nm).

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

description: Qui sommes-nous? Construire. Développer. Pérenniser. Nous faisons ce qui est juste, et nous le faisons bien. Notre approche change la donne en matière de productivité et de qualité, grâce à une collaboration étroite entre l’IA générative et nos meilleurs talents : Nous générons désormais 95 % de l’ensemble du produit — code, documentation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et même le design, le tout propulsé par GitHub Copilot. Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles , tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie. Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering. Votre rôle Pour notre filiale PALO IT LABS basée à Paris et entièrement axée sur le développement de notre méthodologie Gen-e2 , vous serez amené à utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe pour accélérer les cycles de développement et stimuler l’innovation. En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA , de la phase de découverte à la livraison . Vous serez responsable de l’excellence technique, du développement des compétences de l’équipe et du succès client , en veillant à ce que chaque projet soit aligné avec le modèle Gen-e2 speed-to-impact. En tant qu’ AI Native Lead Architect, vos missions principales seront : Leadership technique & Architecture Définir les périmètres de services et les architectures de référence, en alignement avec les SLOs, les politiques de sécurité et les objectifs d’optimisation des coûts. Piloter le contexte engineering (fonctionnel et technique) au sein du référentiel produit, en garantissant transparence et qualité via des templates PR automatisés et le respect des normes documentaires. Réaliser des analyses de risques et menaces , en arbitrant entre performances, confidentialité, durabilité et sécurité. Concevoir et mettre en place des garde-fous dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex. anonymisation des données sensibles, vérification des licences, gates de conformité) pour garantir une qualité de niveau entreprise. Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes. Engagement collaboratif Faciliter la collaboration avec les sponsors techniques et les équipes produit , en tant que référent d’expertise technique. Participer aux phases de pitch, proof-of-concept et développement de l’écosystème et des artefacts . Coaching & Facilitation du changement Mentorer et guider les équipes de développement, favorisant une culture d'apprentissage et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation tout en garantissant le delivery du développement technique . Participer aux revues de code, en fournissant des r etours constructifs et des suggestions d'amélioration . Rester informé(e) des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques, et évaluer leur impact potentiel sur les opérations commerciales et la performance de l’équipe. Vous êtes au bon endroit si Vous êtes un(e) architecte logiciel et Tech Lead confirmé(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à intégrer les méthodes IA-First dans des solutions techniques robustes et scalables. Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en architecture et développement logiciel (Java, .net, Python, React, Angular...) et IA, avec une appétence forte pour la technique et une capacité à être hands-on; Une forte expertise dans la conception et le scaling d’applications cloud-native ou d’architectures AI-First; Une maîtrise approfondie des processus CI/CD, des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), des technologies de containerisation, et des pratiques DevSecOps; Une familiarité avec les approches UX-as-Code et la pensée design system; Une capacité à accompagner et mentorer des équipes diverses dans le développement et l’implémentation de solutions techniques; Un anglais fluide et d’excellentes capacités de communication auprès d’audiences techniques comme non techniques. Vous comprenez des principes de prompt engineering pour une interaction optimale des outils d’IA ; Vous avez une connaissance et curiosité élevées des technologies IA/ML, incluant OpenAI API, LangChain, Hugging Face et le context engineering. Vous avez une pensée critique et analytique pour valider et vérifier le code et les solutions générés par l’IA ; Vous avez une volonté permanente d’apprendre et de vous tenir informé de l’évolution rapide du paysage de l’IA ; Vous êtes sensible aux questions sociales, environnementales et Tech For Good et les intégrez dans ce que vous construisez ; Les profils de nos consultantes et consultants sont tous diversifiés, et nous sommes fier.es de cette richesse. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si votre profil ne répond pas à 100 % à cette annonce, nous valorisons également: Le partage de votre engagement, vos connaissances techniques, votre volonté et votre enthousiasme dans des conférences ou communautés de développement et de Software Craftsmanship ; Votre participation à un ou plusieurs projets Open Source , en tant que contributeur.rice, par exemple ; Votre passion pour l'éco-conception, les défis sociaux modernes, l’innovation dans les domaines humains et le développement durable ; Votre engagement dans des associations ou meetups autour de l’humain et de l’environnement. Ce que nous vous offrons Un terrain de jeu à la hauteur de votre expertise: des missions sélectionnées pour leur complexité, leur exigence d’ingénierie et leur impact business et sociétal. Un coach de carrière dédié qui vous accompagne avec des séances régulières pour structurer, suivre et accélérer vos objectifs de développement. Une communauté technique exigeante et bienveillante : revues de code, pair programming, partage et mentoring pour élever en continu le craft et la rigueur. Parcours de montée en compétences Gen-e2 dès la semaine 1 et tout au long de votre onboarding. Des certifications Microsoft et GitHub financées dès l’onboarding. De l’idée au partage: lab R&D interne, open source by default, conférences tech et dojos d’innovation pour expérimenter, coder, transmettre. Mais également 🌍 Carrière globale , missions multi-secteurs et potentiellement multi-pays, passerelles entre 11 bureaux. 🏠 Remote Friendly en fonction du projet , les jours en présentiel se vivent chez les clients ou dans nos bureaux à République, Paris avec des réunions d'équipe pour partager et innover. Des missions en full présentiel pourront être déployées. 🌱 Impact Academy formations climat, numérique responsable et accessibilité intégrées à nos pratiques. 🤝 Engagement solidaire volontariats en équipe, mécénat de compétences. 🥗🩺 Swile pour les tickets resto, Alan pour une santé bien couverte. raw.title: 📱 Fullstack Developer
raw.description:
🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

  • Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)

In the meantime, meet Robin, our CTO & Head of Product:

In 5 years of existence, we've managed to: 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself. The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot : invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot. Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production. raw.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
raw.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)

If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. Et ensuite... : - Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser. Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients. Compétences requises - De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable). - Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales). - Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple). - Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies. - Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions. - Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus. - Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais. - Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle. - Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients. - Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe. - Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). - Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

raw.description:

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances.

Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes.

📋 Tes missions

Support et résolution de problèmes

  • Réceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateurs

  • Comprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métier

  • Apporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptées

  • Assurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complète

  • Escalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produit

  • Garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service

Accompagnement des migrations

  • Aider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans Pennylane

  • Comprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptable

  • Identifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolution

  • Participer à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associés

Amélioration continue et partage d’expertise

  • Créer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateurs

  • Identifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clients

  • Partager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipe

  • Faire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produit

  • Proposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes

🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane

Les 3 premiers mois

  • Tu suis la Pennylane Academy et te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipe

  • Tu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départements

  • Tu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement

  • Tu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilité

Entre 4 et 6 mois

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en bout

  • Tu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexes

  • Tu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissances

  • Tu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produit

Et ensuite

Tu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets. Des évolutions vers des sujets Support plus complexes, la gestion de comptes ou la mise en œuvre de Pennylane sont également possibles.

🙋 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Formation comptable : BTS CGO, DCG, BTS Assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Bachelor Responsable administratif et comptable, Master CCA ou équivalent

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’expertise-comptable

  • Idéalement, au moins trois périodes fiscales réalisées

  • Une expérience en contact direct avec des dirigeants est un plus

  • Solides connaissances des principes comptables et de la réalité des cabinets

  • Appétence pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies

  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à résoudre des problèmes

  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogie

  • Sens du service et aisance dans la relation client

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter rapidement

  • Envie d’apprendre et de suivre les évolutions du produit

  • Anglais professionnel (compréhension écrite, orale et expression écrite)

  • La connaissance de Pennylane est un plus

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un recruteur, 30 minutes

  2. Un entretien et un cas pratique avec un membre de l'équipe, 1 heure

  3. Un entretien final avec la manager d'équipe, 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t’offrir

  • Une mutuelle Alan Blue et Alan Mind

  • Des tickets restaurant via Swile

  • Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

  • Un budget mensuel pour travailler depuis chez toi ou dans un espace de coworking

  • Des bureaux situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare, à Paris

  • Une enveloppe de BSPCE

  • Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités bien-être via Gymlib

  • Un Mac

  • Un accès à Busuu pour perfectionner ton anglais

  • Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois et un séminaire annuel

  • Des activités sportives et des événements réguliers entre collègues

🌱 Pour t’épanouir chez Pennylane

  • Tu apprécies évoluer dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Tu fais de la collaboration une priorité

  • Tu sais prendre du recul et prioriser les actions à fort impact

  • Tu es à l’aise avec l’idée d’apprendre et d’améliorer continuellement tes pratiques

  • Tu peux travailler en anglais, selon les exigences du poste

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. Les parcours les plus intéressants ne sont pas toujours linéaires. Ce qui compte, c’est ta trajectoire, ton expertise, ta façon de réfléchir et ton envie de contribuer.

You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up.

You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth.

International contracts

  • Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany.

  • Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers.

  • Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments.

  • Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process.

Customer, reseller and integrator agreements

  • Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe.

  • Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations.

  • Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers.

  • Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act.

  • Contribute to contract templates and playbooks.

Legal operations and collaboration

  • Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability.

  • Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams.

  • Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane.

  • You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company.

  • You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German.

  • You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements, including IP, indemnification, liability caps, SLAs and data-related provisions.

  • You are autonomous and comfortable managing matters from start to finish.

  • You have experience working in a multi-jurisdictional environment, particularly across France and Europe.

  • You are interested in legal operations and technology, and have experience structuring processes or optimizing contract management tools.

  • You are a genuine business partner, able to help teams move quickly while protecting the company.

  • You are rigorous, concise and able to make complex legal topics clear to non-legal audiences.

  • You enjoy building in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity, prioritization and rapid iteration are part of the job.
